1.text: Maze Yobu yongera guca imigani ye ati

2.text: “Iyaba nari meze nko mu bihe bya kera,Nko mu minsi Imana yandindaga!

3.text: Icyo gihe itabaza ryayo ryamurikiraga ku mutwe,Nkagendera mu mwijima nyobowe n'umucyo wayo,

4.text: Nk'uko nari meze mu minsi y'ubukwerere bwanjye,Imana ikingīra inama mu rugo rwanjye.

5.text: Ishoborabyose yari ikiri kumwe nanjye,Abana banjye bankikije.

6.text: Intambwe zanjye zari zaranyuzwe n'amavuta,Urutare rukansukira imigezi y'amavuta ya elayo.

7.text: Iyo najyaga ku irembo ry'umudugudu,Ngatereka intebe yanjye mu muharuro,

8.text: Abasore barambonaga bakihisha,Na bo abasaza bakampagurukira bagahagarara.

10.text: Ijwi ry'imfura ryaroroshywaga,Ururimi rwazo rugafatana n'urusenge rw'akanwa kabo.

11.text: “Ugutwi kwanyumvaga kwanyitaga uhiriwe,N'ijisho ryambonaga ryamberaga umuhamya,

12.text: Yuko nakizaga umukene utaka,N'impfubyi na yo itagira gifasha.

13.text: N'uwendaga gupfa wese yansabiraga umugisha,Kandi ngatuma umutima w'umupfakazi uririmbishwa no kunezerwa.

14.text: Nambaraga gukiranuka kukanyambika,Kutabera kwanjye kwari kumeze nk'umwitero n'ikamba.

16.text: Nari se w'umukene,Ngakurikirana urubanza rw'uwo nari ntazi.

17.text: Navunaga inzasaya z'umunyabyaha,Nkamushikuza umunyago mu menyo ye.

18.text: “Maze nkavuga nti‘Nzapfira mu rugo rwanjye,Kandi nzagwiza iminsi yanjye ingane n'imisenyi.

19.text: Umuzi wanjye wari ushoreye mu mazi,N'ikime cyatondaga ku ishami ryanjye bukarinda bucya.

20.text: Ubwiza bwanjye bwahoraga bwiyuburura,Umuheto wanjye ugakomerera mu ntoki zanjye.’

21.text: Abantu bantegeraga amatwi bagategereza,Bagaceceka ngo bumve inama yanjye.

22.text: Iyo namaraga kuvuga nta cyo basubizaga,Ibyo mvuze bikabatonyangaho.

23.text: Kandi bantegerezaga nk'imvura,Bakasama nk'abasamira imvura y'itumba.

24.text: N'iyo twahuzaga urugwiro na bo nseka,Ntibakundaga kubyemera,Kandi ntabwo bahinduraga umucyo wo mu maso hanjye.

25.text: Nakundaga kujya mu nzira yabo nkababera umutware,Nkabamerera nk'umwami mu ngabo ze,Nk'umuhumuriza w'ababoroga.
